description.value:
You upgrade a weapon to fire ammunition that can make precise adjustments to its position in space to better track targets. A creature using the weapon reduces the penalty for firing into the weapon's second range increment from –2 to 0. Additionally, whenever a creature makes a ranged Strike with the weapon that targets a single creature, the attack ignores the target's circumstance bonus to AC from cover.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 weapons.

target.value: 1 ranged weapon with the tech trait
